scenario.title: Human Resources EMAIL verification request
scenario.opening_hook: A HR Officer receives a email related to HRIS portal.
scenario.subject: Human Resources EMAIL verification request
scenario.body_html: Hello Daniel Pattana, please verify this HRIS portal request through the approved process.
red_flags: Urgent request through an unusual path
Verification is pushed outside the approved process
scenario.correct_action: Pause, verify through a trusted separate channel, and report if it cannot be confirmed.
learning_focus: Recognize social engineering involving employee data and HR workflows
Verify requests affecting payroll, benefits, leave, or employee records

game_choices.label: Ask inside the same message, then proceed.
game_choices.feedback: This still uses an untrusted channel.

game_choices.label: Pause, verify through an approved channel, and report if needed.

scenario.hint_text: Use a trusted workflow or separate channel before acting.

hysteresis_rule.note: Promotion requires stronger evidence than holding steady, to reduce stage oscillation.
